top_signals.title: Just one in three Americans back Iran war, most unsure of Trump’s goals, poll finds
top_signals.summary: A Reuters/Ipsos poll found that 69% of Americans think President Donald Trump has not “clearly explained the goals of U.S. military involvement in Iran.”
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Cyber Command plans Silicon Valley office to drive innovation
top_signals.summary: The outpost will have its own director, though no one has yet been named for the post, and support the command’s nascent Cyber Warfare Innovation Center (CIWC).
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: South Korea Issues Heat Wave Alert as Temperature Hits Record
top_signals.summary: South Korea issued emergency heat wave instructions as the country sweltered, with its highest temperature on record reported in the southeastern city of Yangsan.

top_signals.title: Analysts back Strategy’s cash buildup as Saylor shifts from ‘100% bitcoin’ approach
top_signals.summary: TD Cowen and Benchmark reiterated buy on Strategy after an $8.2 billion Q2 loss and a corporate STRC-to-par push.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: By picking 76ers, LeBron James seeks chance to bolster case to be NBA’s GOAT
top_signals.summary: James has said a number of times over the years his goal is to go down as the GOAT, and he has said multiple times he believes he has already earned that distinction.
